name: Bishoujo Rumi Mujaki na Yuuwaku
original_name: 美少女るみ 無邪気な誘惑
source:
The daughter of the landlord is invited by our lolicon protagonist to escape a marital dispute.

She first uses his PC to browse pornographic sites, then our protagonist becomes the target of her sexual curiosity.
